people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: So Joab came to the king, and told him; and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king, and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king; and the king kissed Absalom.
translations.bsb: So Joab went and told the king, and David summoned Absalom, who came to him and bowed facedown before him. Then the king kissed Absalom.
translations.kjv: So Joab came to the king, and told him: and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king, and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king: and the king kissed Absalom.
